book.name: Matyu
book.title: MATYU Kamambuno wakai Matyu muno boglkwa

content: Mokna mongo sunduglkwa ka dibogl dungwa
Ande enge suwara igle, Yesus yungu i kondo pandigl ende menda pi, nigl numbun bina amedi moglkwa.
Moglko yagl ambu merkinde wu ye moglmara makaisi winambo dingwa pre, ye pi bot mina suna amedi moglko, ana yagl ambu ye nigle bina andigl meglkwa.
Ana yegl eriko, Yesus ka mere di simbogl yegl dungwa,
“Yomba ta ye mokna mongo sunduraglendi kongunmo mina ongwa.
Ana ye sundugl ongo, mongo tau yange konbauna sungwa, ana kua undre i ne kondingwa.
Ana mongo tau yange kombuglo moglmara singwa, igle makan tembe kurita yongwa pre tambre kana wisungwa.
Ana ande ende egli ungwa enge, mokna ande de yamuno ana ye gigle geglkwa, sraglpre ye duglono ende atne pi kuno erekrukwa pre ana ye geglkwa.
Ana mongo tau yange kugl kangigle yaglmara suna sungwa. Igle pare wisi egli ungo, ana kugl kinde i bogl wu egli pi, ana i bre atne endungwa.
Ana mongo tau yange makan burkono dumara sungwa, i ana mongo merkinde koglkwa; endiye tau mongo 100 koglkwa, tau 60 koglkwa, te tau 30 koglkwa.
Ana yomba ta kina panan, ka i pro do.”
Yesus ka di simbogl dungura i mambunomo dungwa
Ana Yesus disaipelma wagle ye moglmara wu krapoglte yegl dingwa, “Ene sraglpre ka di simbogl yomba ditene?”
Ana Yesus di ikine endungwa, “Heven kingdom kamambuno teke pangwa i God ombunodi ene tekondungwa. Ba yomba tau i ta tekrukwa.

Te yomba taragl ta ake moglkwa pre ana God taragl tau ama akiye tenan, ana ye taragl merkinde pai tenambuka. Ba yomba taragl i ta ake moglkrambuka, ana ye kurita ake moglkwa, i God i-eglke endinambuka.
Mambuno yeglpre na ka di simbogl diteinga:

content.text: sikrikwa, te ye ka pirm imba, pir kuno erekrikwa.

content: I pre propet Aisaia ka okuna dungwa, i ye mina plau dungwa:

content.text: ana ye kan akete na mina
endinaglkwa, ana na ye erewakai ere tenaglka.’

content: Ba ene ongumutno taragl kanigwa, te kinano ka pirkwa, ana i pre God eran ene gun yenaglkwa.

Na ka kaima ene diteinga, propet wagle ya te God yombamo du-yene merkinde erme ene taragl kanigwa i ye okuna kanamnedi ere wingwa, ba ye ta kankrikwa. Te ene ka pirkwa, i ye piramnedi ere wingwa ba ta pirkrikwa.
Yesus mokna mongo sindiglkwa ka di simbogl dungura i mambuno dipene endungwa
“Ana mokna mongo sindiglkwa ka di simbogl diga pirkura i mambunomo diteimbo pirpogl sinaglkwa.

Yomba heven kingdom kamambuno i diga pirkwa, ba pirpogl sikrimbi ana ye mokna mongo yange konbauna bange sungwa yeglmere. Ana Satan undre mokna mongo yange nomano mina suna yongwa ikra ake towasi ikorugl endungwa.
Te mokna mongo tau yange makan kombuglo moglmara sungwa, i yomba ta kamambuno digo pir indre oglandi gun yongwa yeglmere.
Ba ye ka i nomano mina suna kaima pikrukwa pre, enge sungunagle keme ye mina yongwa. Ana God kamo pre kunda ya yumbun kande ungwa enge ana ye oglandi yange singwa.

Te mongo tau yange kugl kangigle ormara sungwa, i yomba ta kamambuno prukwa, ba ye manginagle moglpai erambuka ya te bona gana sinambuka taragl i nomanemo kande pangwa, yeglpre kamambuno prukwa i si-atne endungo ye mongo koglkrukwa.
Ba mongo tau yange makan burkono dumara sungwa i yegl, yomba ta ye kamambuno pirtre ana pirpogl sinaglkwa. Ye mongo keglkwa, tau mina mongo 100 korambuka te tau 60 te tau 30, yegl di kogl enaglkwa.”
Kugl kinde di simbogl dungwa
Yesus ka ta ama di simbogl yegl ditongwa, “Heven kingdom i yomba ta mokna mongo wakai ipi kongunmo mina sundugl ongwa yeglmere.
Ba enduwer suna yomba uglpai kondigo, ye kundamo ikine undre, kugl kinde mongo ipi wit yaglmara suna sundugl kondo ana teke endongwa.
Ana wit wisi mongo koragledi orko, ye kanigo kugl kinde ama akiye bogl egli ungwa.
“Ana kongunmo yomba undre kongun nemyagl moglmara yegl diteingwa, ‘Yagl kande, no punga ene wit mongo wakai keunde kongun mina sundugl engra. Ba kugl kinde sraglmere ere wu suna pare pame?’
“Ye ditongwa, ‘I kunda ikine ta sunduglko parkwa.’ “Yegl dungo ana kongun yomba dingwa, ‘Ene prawedi pirmin no pi puro endinamno mo?’
“Ba ye yegl ditongwa, ‘Taman, ene kugl kinde i puro endinamnedi ere kawa tenan wit ama akiye puro ende dinaglkwa.

Ye pra suwo-akiye pai embir mongo uraglkwa enge mangigl eran ana uraglkwa yomba yegl ditenaglka. Okuna kana ene pi kugl kinde kan puro gagltenge eraglkwa pre koglo sinaglkwa. Ana okuwo wit mongo uro makaisi ipi na kaiya moknana yungu yungugl yenaglkwa.’”
Mastet mongo di simbogl ka pandum dungwa
Ana Yesus ka ta di simbogl yegl ditongwa, “Heven kingdom i mastet mongo mereyegl, yomba ta mastet mongo indre ana ye kongunmo mina suna yaglkwa.
Mokna mongo tau pare wimara suna i mastet mongo kembra kinde kaima yongwa, ba ye pare pond kaima pai mokna tau engre wu ende mereyegl ongo, ana kua wu yongagle mina yunguno yeingwa.”
Yis pre dibogl ka pandum dungwa
Yesus ka ta ama dibogl yegl ditongwa, “Heven kingdom i yis mereyegl. Ambu ta yis tau indre ana plawa bogl dis mina sikugl ende nokungo ana ake bei puro dungwa.”
Yesus ka dungwa i ka di simbogl keunde dungwa
Yesus yomba merkinde meglmara taragl prapra ka di simbogl dungwa i ka mongo kaima ta ditekrukwa. Ye ka di simbogl keunde ditongwa.
Yegl orkwa i propet ta ka yegl dungo pangwa i mongo kaima paiyungwa. Ana propet i ka yegl dungwa:
Yesus kugl kinde pre ka di simbogl dungura i mambunomo dipene endungwa
Ana Yesus yomba merkinde kindekondo ende yungugl ongo, ana disaipelma wagle ye moglmara undre yegl dingwa, “Ene kongun mina suna kugl kinde pre ka dibogl dinga ikra mambunomo dinoro.”
Ana Yesus di ikine endungwa, “Yomba ta mokna mongo wakai sunduglkwa, iwe Yomba Wam.
Te kongun ereyaglkwa dumo iwe makan koglkoglo. Te mokna mongo wakai iwe heven kingdom inaglkwa yomba. Te kugl kinde iwe, yomba kinde Satan nangiglma.
Te kunda ikine ta kugl kinde mongo sunduglkwa, iwe Satan. Te mokna simakai sinaglkwa enge iwe, dumo makan dundinambuka enge. Te mokna si imakai sinaglkwa yomba iwe angelo.
“Te kugl kinde puro ende donga mina suna ende gagltenge erikwa yeglmere, ana enge kande mina kuno yegl plau dinambuka.
Yomba Wam angelomo diendinan, ye pi God kingdomo mina yombamo mambuno kinde kanekane erikwa ya, te taragl kinde kanekane erimbi yomba tandaglme eraglkwa, angelo imenda endinaglkwa.
Ana donga aimande de bauglo ere pamara i ye piyasi suna endimbi, igle ana kai kaglkane ere singino gikir ere moraglkwa.
Te du-yene meglkwa yomba ye Neno kingdom mina sunakra ande mereyegl ambuglangesi moraglkwa. Yomba ta ye kina panan ka i pra pirondo.
Minge moni teke yeingwa pre ka dibogl dungwa

“Heven kingdom i minge moni mereyegl kongun ere yaglmara suna teke yeingwa yeglmere. Ana yagl ta kan indre, ye aglke kordagl simbi dungwa. Yegl ere ye gun pond yei, ana pi taraglmo prapra yomba tendre topo bogl i-kondo, ana ende ikine pi makan i topo orkwa.
Bis topo pond boglkwa dibogl dungwa
“Ama ta yegl, heven kingdom i yagl ta bis wakai-yene pre dokungwa yeglmere.
Ana ye bis wakai-yene topo kande borambuka ta kandre, ye endpi taraglmo prapra topo bogl i-kondo, ana pi bis ikra topo orkwa.
Fis gagl pre di simbogl dungwa
“Ta ama yegl, heven kingdom i fis singwa gagl yeglmere, yomba tau gatno indre piyasi nigl numbun moglmara ende fis kanekane singwa.
Ana fis gagl i kau sungo fis singwa yomba ikra gundo i-bina eingwa. Pindre ana amedi mogl fis yumbusi, wakai kan i basket gre, kinde kan piyasi kinde kondingwa.
Enge kande makandle plau dinambuka i kuno yegl. Angelo ende menda undre, ana yomba kinde ye yomba du-yene meglmara pukamugl meglkwa i pinde i-eglke ende,
ana piyasi donga bauglo mina suna endimbi, igle ye ende de kai kaglkane ere singino gikir ere moraglkwa.”
Yesus krapogl tongwa, “Ene ka i prapra mambunomo pirmo?” Ye di ikine ende dingwa, “Owo.”

Ana ye yegl ditongwa, “Yeglpre ana lo beke teingwa yomba ye heven kingdom ka i okuna mambuno ere beke pir kondimbi, ye yungu nemyagl mereyegl mogl, yungu kiule taragl ake-nongwa yomara kor ya te goglo akiye imenda ungwa.”
Nasaret yomba Yesus mokono teingwa
Yesus ka merkinde di simbogl dungwa i pra dundungo, ye kamun igle kondo endongwa.

Ye ende ikine yene makanmo bre mina undre, makai yungu yomara igle yomba ka beke tongo pirtre, ana ye kundugl di alagl sindre ana ye krapeglkwa, “Yagl i pirpogl sungwa ya te kimagl orkwa yombuglo i aglokra beke yum manda?
Yomba i kamda wam moglkwa. Ye mam kangiye Maria, te angiglma wagle, Jems, Josep, Saimon te Judas.
Ye ambaglma wagle prapra nono bogl akiye meglkwa. Ye taragl i prapra aglokra yum manda?”
Ana ye deno kumbruko pir kinde yei teingwa. Ba Yesus ditongwa, “Propet ta kamun bange bange enan ye pra pirmitna ende tenaglkwa, ba yene kamunmo bre ya kei pamara i ta kangiye paikrambuka.”
Ana yomba ye pirngino paikrukwa, ipre ye dumo igle kimagl merkinde ta erekrukwa.

footnotes.text: Matyu pepa muno boglmara i Yesus ka dungwa oltokuri namba 3 dungwa i pangwa. Ka i Matyu 13:3-52 mina pangwa ana heven kingdom mambunomo simbogl dungwa i merkinde pangwa.
